root_cause_label: AWK peak extraction emits 9174 rows instead of 184 due to array initialization over-range causing all frames 0-999 to satisfy the print condition, plus STFT computed from pre-quantization float signal rather than WAV-loaded int16 domain
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent's AWK implementation initializes top-3 tracking arrays for indices 0-999, causing max_frame to be 999 and emitting rows for all initialized frames (many spurious) rather than exactly one row per STFT frame, producing 9174 rows instead of 184; the agent observed this mismatch at step 44 but never fixed it and issued a false completion claim.
t_err_evidence: awk rewrite for top-3 per frame; logic emits many rows per frame instead of exactly one row per frame
t_commit_evidence: Step 44 runs the full pipeline and the terminal output explicitly shows 'Generated peaks.csv with 9174 frames (excluding header)' against an STFT of 184 frames; after this point the agent performs only verification theater and never attempts to fix the AWK logic, locking in the failure.
trigger_explanation: The agent correctly planned a streaming per-frame top-3 AWK approach at step 35 but the generated AWK code has a subtle bug: pre-initializing 1000 array entries causes the `for (f in val1)` loop to find max_frame=999 instead of 183, so the output loop emits rows for all 1000 initialized indices rather than only the 184 actual frames; the agent could not reliably generate correct AWK array boundary logic.
